in_arabic.name: Dagar
in_arabic.long_meaning: Dagar هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word ‘dāgar’, meaning ‘mountain’. This name reflects a sense of strength, endurance, and stability, symbolizing the steadfastness of a mountain that stands tall and unwavering.
